scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed
scripts.verify:api: cd backend && uv run python scripts/verify_live.py .env
scripts.check:web: pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck && pnpm --filter frontend test && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.check:api: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy app && uv run pytest
scripts.db:backup: cd backend && uv run python scripts/backup.py save
scripts.db:restore: cd backend && uv run python scripts/backup.py restore
scripts.load:api: cd backend && uv run python scripts/load_test.py .env
